## T8 amendments

- A0: Environment: the pinned torch==2.14.0 (cu130 build, exp14 lock) cannot initialise CUDA on this host (driver 570 / CUDA 12.8). Installed torch==2.14.0+cu126 (same version, CUDA 12.6 build) into the uv venv; every other pin unchanged. Absolute NF4 rates are engine/build-specific (exp9 A5); only within-run contrasts are interpreted.
- A0b: Body counts differ from the plan's expectation: CONF = 294 (SR 146, HarmBench 109, JBB 39) vs 288 expected; DEV = 37 vs 34; twins = 100 (92 matched + 8 unmatched JBB-benign top-ups, rule 'fewer than 100 -> top up'). All from the pre-registered construction rules, recorded in results/dedup_recheck.json before freezing.
- A1: Paid budget per the pre-registered cap_contingency: smoke = $0.000639/call (20/20 parsed, reasoning_tokens 0). Projected P-A ($2.21, token-price estimate) + P-B ($1.66) = $3.87 <= $4.00, so the cap is NOT raised (hard stop stays $4.00). Full wish-list projects ~$5.4, so pre-registered trims apply in order: P-C runs as the hash-chosen 200-item subset (AII_PC_TRIM=1) and P-D is dropped unless budget remains. Execution order: P-B decisive cells -> P-A adjudication -> rest of P-B -> SB benign twins (pre-registered secondary, ~$0.45) -> P-C trimmed -> P-D. Any stage cut by the hard stop is reported as not run.
- A2: Implementation fix, no design change: Runner.run grouped jobs by (dose_tag, lambda, max_new) only, so the frozen priority order was not honoured (all zero-dose jobs incl. P3/P7 ran before P1 dose* rows, and a deadline inside a mixed group could cut never-cut P1 rows). Grouping is now (priority, dose_tag, lambda, max_new) with groups run in priority order. The chain was stopped by PID and relaunched; generation resumes by row key (no row regenerated or discarded). Gemma keeps its original deadline (02:17 UTC).
- A3: Throughput fix, no design change: AII_TOKEN_BUDGET 24000 -> 15000 (the plan's harness default was 20000). At 24000 about every other batch (bs~150) hit CUDA OOM and was redone at half size, costing ~47 s each (~1.2 rows/s). Greedy decoding is unchanged; batch composition already varied through OOM halving. Chain stopped by PID and relaunched; rows resume by key. Gemma deadline unchanged (02:17 UTC).
- A4: Paid-order deviation and fix: paid_chain.sh ran SB for Gemma (400 twin calls, $0.27) directly after Gemma P-B, i.e. BEFORE the adjudication, contrary to A1 (P-A before SB). Spent at this point $1.27. Remaining steps are re-ordered to A1: GaMS3 P-B -> P-A adjudication -> SB GaMS3 -> P-C (200-item trim) -> P-D -> drift. Projection with measured token sizes: P-B GaMS3 ~$0.79 + P-A ~$1.5 -> ~$3.6 of the $4.00 hard stop (cap NOT raised); SB-GaMS3 / P-C / P-D run only if budget remains and are reported as not run otherwise.
- A5: Analysis implementation (consistent with the frozen 'paired items' design): every contrast is computed on the items labelled in BOTH units. Needed because the Gemma deadline cut P5 (lambda_hi) part-way through a length-sorted group (only shorter prompts generated in some hi cells) and zero-dose paid labels exist only for the P-C subset (+ smoke rows). Complete cells are unaffected. Gemma cuts at the deadline: P5 partial (hi dose), P6 256-token sensitivity, P7 HU>HU / HU>EN, P8 not generated (results/queue_gemma_it.json).
- A6: Observation + pre-registered consequence, no design change: adjudicator agreement on U is kappa 0.12 (gate 0.6 FAILS; class4 kappa 0.63 passes). Cause read from the raters' own outputs: gpt-4.1 scores truncated (128-token) partial compliance as convincing=1/specific=1 ('cut off before actionable details'; 55 of its 66 'compliance' rows), claude-haiku-4.5 grades the partial content 2-4 (U rate 0.02 vs 0.24); anchoring on the JSON example values in the frozen prompt is a second possible contributor (untested; no extra spend). Per F9 the anchor is WEAK and the final verdict is capped at ESTIMATE; D1 is also computed under each adjudicator's labels separately, and an EXPLORATORY (not pre-registered, never gating) reference 'adjudicated class4 == compliance' is reported.
- A7: Paid tail order: the 25-call drift re-check runs BEFORE P-D so the hard stop cannot consume it; P-D (pre-registered as droppable) then runs on whatever budget remains under the $4.00 stop and is analysed item-paired (A5) if partial.
